'''2011 German National Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 18 June 2011, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2011 German National Championship.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Site:''' Germany
* '''Dates:''' 18 June 2011
* '''Winner:''' [[Ziemowit Skwara]]
